summary: Firecrawl's Student Program gives verified students 10,000 free credits for educational or personal projects. Eligibility requires a valid academic email address and enrollment in a college, university, or accredited program. Credits are added instantly after redeeming the student coupon code in Settings → Billing. Distinct from the ongoing Firecrawl Free Plan.
claim_steps: Sign up for Firecrawl with your educational email address.
Go to Settings → Billing and enter the student coupon code shown on the program page.
10,000 credits are added to your account instantly — no credit card required.

social_proof.title: Firecrawl Student Program
social_proof.text: Verified students get 10,000 free credits. Build real projects with the same API trusted by Apple, Canva, and Lovable.
